$comment: NLLB-200 distilled machine translation (~200 languages, any direction) on Sigil's own ONNX Runtime, CPU background profile (owned by P4-D; engine src-tauri/src/services/mt_local/nllb.rs, ids mt_local::NLLB_DEFAULT_MODEL / NLLB_LARGE_MODEL, TS NLLB_MODELS).

Each entry is one folder: encoder_model_quantized.onnx (input_ids, attention_mask -> last_hidden_state), decoder_model_merged_quantized.onnx (Optimum's merged decoder with KV cache and use_cache_branch), tokenizer.json (Hugging Face tokenizers, SentencePiece BPE plus the FLORES-200 language tokens), config.json and generation_config.json. The engine also accepts the other Optimum names (encoder_model.onnx, decoder_model_merged.onnx, *_int8 / *_uint8, an onnx/ subfolder) for local folders.

600M: Xenova's transformers.js export (8-bit dynamic quantization of every MatMul and the embeddings), pinned to a repo commit with the LFS sha256 by scripts/models/pin-catalog.mjs --fragment src-tauri/model-catalog/mt-nllb.json --only mt/nllb-200-distilled-600m --write (the 1.3B entry has no release to look up while unpublished).

1.3B: no maintained ONNX export exists on Hugging Face, so it is Sigil-built by scripts/mt-bench/export_nllb.py (Optimum export plus the same 8-bit quantization, zipped) and starts 'unpublished' (install it by local import in Models & Runtimes or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS until it is on the assets-v1 release) or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS. Size and sha256 are pinned from the script's .sha256 file (scripts/models/pin-staged.mjs); publish-entries.mjs flips the status after the upload.

entries.title: NLLB-200 600M (offline translation, 200 languages)
entries.description: Meta's No Language Left Behind translator: about 200 languages in any direction, fully offline on the processor (no graphics memory). Best for languages the other offline translators do not cover. About 0.9 GB download.

entries.title: NLLB-200 1.3B (offline translation, 200 languages, higher quality)
entries.description: The larger NLLB-200 translator: better translations than the 600M model for the same 200 languages, still offline on the processor, about twice as slow. About 1.7 GB download.
